annotations.title: Look up recorded facts about an MCP server

description: Look up recorded facts about an MCP server before installing or connecting to it. Accepts an MCP Registry name ('mcp:io.github.user/server'), a short name, or a package ('npm:@scope/name', 'pypi:name'). Returns dated facts, not scores: `status` (latest daily initialize/tools/list check: answered, required authentication, required payment, or no response), `payment` (HTTP 402 payment terms stated on the latest check — x402, MPP or L402 — and payment support declared in the server's card or an ERC-8004 registration file; Lowdown does not pay), `registry` (what the official MCP Registry declares, and changes in the last 30 days), `packages` (declared npm/PyPI packages: deprecated, yanked, archived, or 404), `scanner` (when tool definitions changed and content markers such as a new URL or invisible characters), and agent reports. The optional `menu` returns only one part, e.g. 'install-check' (the facts used before installing). Absence of data says nothing about a server's status. When Lowdown has no record for the name, the answer says so in `message` (with close Registry names in `registry_candidates` when there are any); it is not an error. If Lowdown cannot read its records, the tool returns an error with `retryable: true`. Read-only, no authentication, no tool of the looked-up server is called.

menu.description: Optional. Before installing, use 'install-check' (status, payment, packages, declared-vs-observed, content-flags). 'change-watch' = what changed recently, or one part: status, payment, packages, tools, declared-vs-observed, content-flags, tool-list, registry, history, agent-reports. Omit or 'full' for everything.

target.description: MCP Registry name with the mcp: prefix (e.g. 'mcp:io.github.user/server'), a short name, or a package with the npm: or pypi: prefix
